meta.name: render-vignette
meta.description: Assemble a short-form 'vignette' ad from clean product cutouts composited over a kinetic background video — birefnet cutout, then a cold-open text card + product carousel + annotated specimen-sheet end card, plus loudnorm + separate-pass music mux. FREE assembly (PIL + rsvg + FFmpeg); the recipe supplies the config and gates the paid BG/cutout/music calls to their own capabilities. Use for the vignette format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用产品图与动态背景自动合成短视频广告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速制作产品展示短视频广告
copy.tagline_en: Assemble short-form video ads from product cutouts and kinetic backgrounds
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to produce short product showcase video ads

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动把产品图片去底、合成到动态背景视频上，生成一段带开场文字卡、产品轮播和结尾说明卡的短视频广告。全程无语音，靠音乐和屏幕文字传递信息。
howto.when: 当你要求制作一条“vignette”格式的短视频广告，并提供了产品图片、背景视频和品牌配置信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这款洗发水图片做一条 vignette 广告。
say.note: Claude 会调用去底、合成等步骤生成视频。

say.text: 用这些产品图生成一个 9:16 的 vignette 视频。
say.note: Claude 会按默认结构组装视频。

say.text: 为这个品牌做一条音乐驱动的产品展示短视频。
say.note: Claude 会使用提供的品牌配置生成广告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically remove backgrounds from product images, composite them onto a dynamic background video, and generate a short video ad with a cold-open text card, product carousel, and annotated end card. No voiceover; music and on-screen text carry the message.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a 'vignette' format short video ad and provide product images, background video, and brand configuration.

say_en.text: Make a vignette ad using this shampoo image.
say_en.note: Claude will run cutout, composite, etc. to generate the video.

say_en.text: Generate a 9:16 vignette video from these product shots.
say_en.note: Claude will assemble the video with default structure.

say_en.text: Create a music-driven product showcase short video for this brand.
say_en.note: Claude will use the provided brand config to produce the ad.
